content: For a Lenovo ThinkCentre M710q, an SSD storage upgrade (NVMe/SATA) provides the greatest practical benefit over RAM or network upgrades. A combined strategy of upgrading to a 1TB+ NVMe SSD (~$75-85) followed by adding RAM if under 16GB (~$20-30) maximizes the $100 budget. Network upgrades offer the lowest ROI for home servers.
